verdict.rationale: Notte's docs claim it can "persist cookies and login state across sessions" (notte-docs-5), and the marketing site advertises "Authenticated Profiles: browser profiles for each agent" (notte-docs-21). Together these cover the core story of reusable logged-in profiles that let agents skip login on later runs. Both are one-line marketing or docs mentions with no detailed profile docs. Missing for 10: in-depth profile API documentation (create/reuse/update lifecycle, expiry handling), independent or hands-on corroboration that saved sessions reliably bypass login walls.
